verdict.rationale: Ramp's Bill Pay docs cover the full AP flow. Invoices are captured by OCR with line-item extraction and two- and three-way matching. Approval workflows are documented as applying to bills, and bills can be approved via the CLI. Vendors can be paid per bill by card, ACH, check, or wire, and ERP-initiated bills can be completed with Ramp payments. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of bill-specific approval routing rules (multi-step or conditional routing is only implied via the shared spend-controls and approval workflow layer), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP flow.
